subject: Draft MAP and blocker remediation for Parallax Health - action alignment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@parallaxhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@parallaxhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and next steps (Parallax Health)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and the first draft of a Mutual Action Plan attached. I pulled the items we discussed into milestone form so we can agree on owners and a target close.

Highlights / asks:
- Target close: 2027-08-20 (initial ask)
- Key milestones:
  • Integration demo (data schema + API): Parallax (Alex) by 2027-08-03
  • Security review (SOC2 evidence + network diagram): Parallax (Priya) by 2027-08-06
  • Pilot provisioning & performance baseline: Redwood (Ben) by 2027-08-10
  • PO and procurement sign-off: Parallax procurement by 2027-08-12
- Dependencies: access to anonymized sample dataset, procurement SLA, test service account with S3 access

Attached: parallax_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (draft) — open to edits. Can you confirm owners/dates above and flag any blockers? If everything looks reasonable, Ben will block out a pilot window and we’ll share a more prescriptive runbook.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: parallax_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)]

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@parallaxhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@parallaxhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and next steps (Parallax Health)

Thanks Jasmine — appreciated the clear MAP. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Integration demo date: 2027-08-03 looks good but can we shift to the afternoon (2pm PT)? We want both API and ETL owners present.
2) Security review: Priya will need our infra diagrams; I asked infra to export the network layout and will attach to the thread once ready. Could you confirm Redwood's expected format for the diagrams (PDF vs Visio)?
3) Procurement: procurement@parallaxhealth.com is on copy — we typically need a statement of work + pricing sheet before PO starts.

Blocker: sample data — we can provide anonymized CSVs, but the schema differs slightly from the sandbox spec you shared. We should list data-mapping as an explicit dependency in the MAP.

I'll loop in our infra lead tomorrow. For now, confirming owners/dates with one caveat on the demo time.

—Alex
Head of Integrations, Parallax Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@parallaxhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@parallaxhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and next steps (Parallax Health)

Thanks Alex — afternoon demo at 2pm PT works for our infra and API leads. To remove ambiguity on the pilot commitment, Redwood can commit to the following (pending dataset access):

- Pilot provisioning slot: week of 2027-08-09 (Ben / Infra team)
- Performance baseline run: 48-hour baseline following provisioning
- Dedicated SME: I will be the primary internal owner for pilot execution and will share a runbook by 2027-08-05.

On the PO timeline — if Parallax can issue a soft PO by 2027-08-12 we can prioritize capacity for the week of 8/9. If PO shifts past 8/12 we may need to push pilot to late August (capacity constraints). Jasmine — can you add that dependency explicitly to the MAP and include the runbook link?

Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: MAP weekly checkpoint — updated v1.1 attached (overdue items flagged)

Hi all — quick weekly checkpoint. I attached an updated MAP (v1.1) with two edits:
- Added explicit data-mapping milestone and owner (Parallax: Alex)
- Marked procurement PO as high priority (overdue if not soft-PO by 2027-08-12)

Current status (brief):
- Integration demo: scheduled for 2027-08-03 14:00 PT — attendees: Parallax API + ETL, Redwood infra + SE
- Security diagrams: Alex to share by 2027-08-01 (still pending) — Priya flagged as blocker
- Pilot provisioning: Redwood preparing runbook; target week 2027-08-09 pending PO

\Action items / asks:
- Alex: upload network diagram to the Drive link and confirm data schema differences by EOD 8/2
- Priya / procurement: confirm PO cadence and whether a soft-PO + SOW will be acceptable for capacity hold
- Parallax procurement: if possible, send a short email confirming PO timeline so we can hold the pilot slot
\Updated attachment: parallax_MAP_v1.1.xlsx and PDF export for distribution.

Thanks — small nudges this week to keep the runway. If you prefer a quick 15-min sync before the demo, I can schedule one.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: parallax_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)]

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the nudge. Quick updates: 

- Network diagram: attaching exported PDF now (will also drop Visio to the Drive).
- Procurement: we can prepare a soft-PO + SOW by 2027-08-11, but final PO will depend on legal review (likely complete by 2027-08-18). Soft-PO should be acceptable to hold capacity.
- Data schema: Alex and I will upload a short mapping doc by EOD 8/2.

This should keep you on the pilot timeline. If anything changes I’ll post here.

—Priya
Director, Security & Compliance, Parallax Health
